verdict.rationale: Bot protection is a fair question for a cloud application platform that serves public traffic and runs a CDN, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing about bot mitigation, challenge pages, or invisible challenges. The closest items are private networking, environment isolation, TLS and CDN caching, which are adjacent security features and do not deliver this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect my app from automated bot traffic with invisible challenge-based protection
